rationale: Red is a pure apple-grabber; the plaza shared-bonus mechanism turns each of Red's plaza pickups into +bonus_value × 12 for the Blue cohort, but only while w_P ≤ bonus_threshold. I widen and stabilize that gate (high threshold, high regrow threshold/prob, max bonus_value) so Red's greed becomes a public good for Blue, and decouple orchard harvesting from waste growth so Red can't DOS Blue's home orchards. Cheaper CLEAN reduces the rotational burden the Latin-square cooperator pays to keep the gate open.
